server.router: The pages folder is scanned at startup and each file compiled to a regular expression, instead of a hand-written route config, so a file is the route. Cost: the table is built once, so a page added later is not routed until the server restarts.
server.render: Server rendering with renderToString instead of client-only rendering, because pages arrive as real HTML for search engines and first paint. Cost: nothing is sent until the whole page has rendered, and there is no streaming.
build: A generated page map of literal import() calls instead of one bundle, so Bun.build splits every page into its own lazy chunk. Cost: the map comes from the routes found at startup, so adding a page needs a rebuild.
